description: Good dogs. Big adventures. Dogs Unleashed is an open-source Fabric mod that adds new dog breeds, and plenty of features to make them feel real.

mods.name: Dogs Unleashed
mods.description: Adds new dog breeds and dog-related items to enhance the player's experience with their canine companions. Breeds spawn naturally across biomes with their own coats, sounds, and personalities. Dogs sleep in dog beds, fetch thrown sticks, follow you between dimensions, and leave a grave behind when they die. Operators can tune spawning, graves, auto-sleep, and bark volume in-game from the settings screen or the /dogsunleashed command.

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* ci: add curseforge publishing by @grabartley in https://github.com/grabartley/minecraft-dogs-unleashed/pull/735
* fix: widen the straw hat, keep paw prints on solid ground, walk dogs round to the dog house door and equip every gear item on right click by @grabartley in https://github.com/grabartley/minecraft-dogs-unleashed/pull/736


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/grabartley/minecraft-dogs-unleashed/compare/v0.5.0...v0.5.1
